clips.title: The story
paras: At the Stonewrought Dam, sabotage threatens a vital barrier in Loch Modan. A barrel hidden near the water holds strange smelling powder, and you bring a sample to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII.

Whispers of sabotage have drawn attention to the shoreline around the Stonewrought Dam. Near the water's edge, an out-of-place barrel holds strange, pungent powder that has no place among the dam's maintenance supplies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you happen to discover any clues, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!
